📖 How to use this app

Report a bug or idea

About:

Reports are saved with the inventory. Whoever looks after the app turns them into tasks the next time they check, which is not on a schedule, so nobody is alerted straight away. Reports are not private: anyone who has the app's address can read them, so leave out anything private. Urgent? Krewe members can email the Virtual Krewe of Vaporwave mailing list: kreweofvaporwave@googlegroups.com (it only accepts mail from members).
